calculation.description: Ranks instruments by 20-day momentum adjusted for whether recent squared-return amplitude is dominated by gains or losses. Positive gain asymmetry reinforces momentum; downside-dominated momentum is penalized. Computed using only information through each signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive across 2020-2022 (0.033893), 2023-2024 (0.024771), and 2025-2027 (0.023160). Five- and ten-day decay were stronger than the one-day admission horizon. Conservative interpretation is warranted because the cross-section contains 15 assets.
